newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: VA Tech sees higher profit growth in 96.
newsitem.headline: VA Tech sees higher profit growth in 96.

text.p: Austrian engineering group VA Technologie AG said on Wednesday it expects to post higher growth in pre-tax profit this year than in 1995, adding it expects to post at least an unchanged dividend.
In 1995, VA Tech paid out a dividend of 28 schillings.

VA Tech said it expects to post double-digit growth in all key earnings apart from in net profit. The company earlier said it expected net profit for the full year to be weighed down by an increased tax burden.
In reference to pre-tax profit, chief executive Othmar Puehringer said: "Growth will be higher than that from 1994 to 1995."

Chief financial officer Helmuth Hamminger added that growth would be more moderate than that in the first half of the year, when pre-tax profit surged 50 percent to 484 million schillings -- well above analysts' expectations. -- Julia Ferguson, Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12 254
